sql_text: SELECT a.aircraft_code, a.model, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM aviation.aircrafts AS a LEFT JOIN aviation.flights AS f ON f.aircraft_code = a.aircraft_code WHERE a.range_km >= 6000 GROUP BY a.aircraft_code, a.model

SELECT t.ticket_no, tf.flight_id, tf.amount FROM aviation.tickets AS t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no WHERE t.passenger_id = '1318-041314' AND tf.fare_conditions = 'Business'

WITH passenger_totals AS (SELECT t.passenger_id, t.passenger_name, COUNT(*) AS segments, SUM(tf.amount) AS total_spent FROM aviation.tickets AS t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no WHERE t.ticket_no BETWEEN '0000000434847' AND '0000000484847' GROUP BY t.passenger_id, t.passenger_name) SELECT passenger_id, passenger_name, segments, total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS spending_rank FROM passenger_totals WHERE total_spent >= 55000 ORDER BY spending_rank LIMIT 100

SELECT f.flight_id, f.flight_no, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights AS f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.flight_id = 40536 GROUP BY f.flight_id, f.flight_no
SELECT scheduled_departure::date AS flight_date, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'SVO' GROUP BY scheduled_departure::date ORDER BY flight_date

WITH route_counts AS (SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM aviation.flights WHERE status = 'On Time' GROUP BY departure_airport, arrival_airport) SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, flight_count, flight_count::numeric / SUM(flight_count) OVER (PARTITION BY departure_airport) AS traffic_share FROM route_counts ORDER BY traffic_share DESC

SELECT f.flight_id, COUNT(DISTINCT tf.ticket_no) AS tickets, COUNT(DISTINCT bp.ticket_no) AS boarded FROM aviation.flights AS f LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes AS bp ON bp.flight_id = tf.flight_id AND bp.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no WHERE f.flight_id = 46175 GROUP BY f.flight_id

WITH capacity AS (SELECT aircraft_code, COUNT(*) AS seats FROM aviation.seats GROUP BY aircraft_code), sold AS (SELECT flight_id, COUNT(*) AS tickets FROM aviation.ticket_flights GROUP BY flight_id) SELECT f.flight_id, f.aircraft_code, c.seats, COALESCE(s.tickets, 0) AS tickets, COALESCE(s.tickets, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(c.seats, 0) AS load_factor FROM aviation.flights AS f JOIN capacity AS c ON c.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code LEFT JOIN sold AS s ON s.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.aircraft_code = 'SU9' ORDER BY load_factor DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT f.flight_id, f.flight_no FROM aviation.flights AS f WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-01-24' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aviation.ticket_flights AS tf WHERE tf.flight_id = f.flight_id)
SELECT ticket_no, passenger_id, passenger_name FROM aviation.tickets WHERE passenger_name LIKE 'Passenger 86674%' ORDER BY ticket_no LIMIT 50

WITH totals AS (SELECT f.aircraft_code, f.departure_airport, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights AS f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.status = 'On Time' GROUP BY f.aircraft_code, f.departure_airport) SELECT aircraft_code, departure_airport, revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY aircraft_code ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM totals WHERE revenue >= 55000 ORDER BY aircraft_code, revenue_rank

WITH route_month AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure) AS month_start, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS sold, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights AS f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.scheduled_departure) = 2 GROUP BY month_start, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport) SELECT month_start, departure_airport, arrival_airport, sold, revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month_start ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS route_rank FROM route_month ORDER BY month_start, route_rank LIMIT 100

SELECT DISTINCT ON (departure_airport, arrival_airport) departure_airport, arrival_airport, flight_no, scheduled_departure FROM aviation.flights WHERE status = 'On Time' ORDER BY departure_airport, arrival_airport, scheduled_departure DESC

SELECT f1.flight_id AS first_flight, f2.flight_id AS second_flight, f1.departure_airport, f1.arrival_airport AS connection_airport, f2.arrival_airport AS destination FROM aviation.flights AS f1 JOIN aviation.flights AS f2 ON f2.departure_airport = f1.arrival_airport AND f2.scheduled_departure BETWEEN f1.scheduled_arrival AND f1.scheduled_arrival + INTERVAL '12 hours' WHERE f1.departure_airport = 'BQT' AND f1.scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-07-14' AND f1.scheduled_departure < DATE '2025-07-21' AND f2.arrival_airport <> f1.departure_airport ORDER BY f1.scheduled_departure LIMIT 100

WITH monthly_average AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', book_date) AS month_start, AVG(total_amount) AS average_amount FROM aviation.bookings GROUP BY date_trunc('month', book_date)) SELECT b.book_ref, b.book_date, b.total_amount FROM aviation.bookings AS b JOIN monthly_average AS m ON m.month_start = date_trunc('month', b.book_date) WHERE b.total_amount > m.average_amount * 1.5 ORDER BY b.total_amount DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM retail.categories c JOIN retail.products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN retail.order_items i ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN retail.customer_orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE c.category_id = 26 AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2023-06-30' - INTERVAL '180 days' GROUP BY c.category_name

SELECT p.brand, o.sales_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, SUM(i.quantity) AS units, AVG(i.unit_price) AS avg_price FROM retail.products p JOIN retail.order_items i ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN retail.customer_orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE p.brand = 'Brand 14' AND o.order_status <> 'cancelled' AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2025-05-21' - INTERVAL '365 days' GROUP BY p.brand, o.sales_channel ORDER BY units DESC

SELECT a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, SUM(o.total_amount) AS gross_sales FROM retail.addresses a JOIN retail.customer_orders o ON o.shipping_address_id = a.address_id WHERE a.region = 'Region 3' AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2025-04-19' - INTERVAL '180 days' GROUP BY a.city ORDER BY gross_sales DESC

SELECT ordered_at::date AS day, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue, AVG(discount_amount) AS avg_discount FROM retail.customer_orders WHERE sales_channel = 'web' AND ordered_at >= DATE '2024-01-20' - INTERVAL '90 days' AND ordered_at < DATE '2024-01-20' + INTERVAL '90 days' AND order_status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY ordered_at::date ORDER BY day

SELECT p.payment_id, p.order_id, p.amount, o.customer_id, o.ordered_at FROM retail.payments p JOIN retail.customer_orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'failed' AND p.payment_method = 'cash' AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2023-04-09' - INTERVAL '120 days' AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2023-04-09' + INTERVAL '120 days' ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS units, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM retail.customer_orders o JOIN retail.order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN retail.products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= DATE '2023-06-14' - INTERVAL '120 days' AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT p.payment_method, COUNT(*) AS refunds, SUM(p.amount) AS refunded, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_order_value FROM retail.payments p JOIN retail.customer_orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'refunded' AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2025-05-04' - INTERVAL '365 days' GROUP BY p.payment_method ORDER BY refunded DESC

SELECT order_id, customer_id, ordered_at, total_amount FROM retail.customer_orders WHERE order_status = 'shipped' AND ordered_at >= DATE '2023-05-12' AND ordered_at < DATE '2023-05-12' + INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY ordered_at DESC LIMIT 250

SELECT second.product_id, p.product_name, COUNT(*) AS together_count FROM retail.order_items first JOIN retail.order_items second ON second.order_id = first.order_id AND second.product_id <> first.product_id JOIN retail.products p ON p.product_id = second.product_id WHERE first.product_id = 12654 GROUP BY second.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY together_count DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT o.sales_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, AVG(b.units) AS avg_units, AVG(b.lines) AS avg_lines FROM retail.customer_orders o JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM retail.order_items GROUP BY order_id) b ON b.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.sales_channel = 'marketplace' AND o.order_status <> 'cancelled' AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2024-09-03' - INTERVAL '180 days' AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2024-09-03' + INTERVAL '180 days' GROUP BY o.sales_channel

SELECT product_id, MAX(quantity) - MIN(quantity) AS stock_spread, AVG(quantity) AS avg_stock, SUM(reserved_quantity) AS reserved FROM retail.inventory GROUP BY product_id HAVING MAX(quantity) - MIN(quantity) > 209 AND AVG(quantity) >= 79 ORDER BY stock_spread DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT w.region, SUM(i.quantity) AS stock, SUM(i.reserved_quantity) AS reserved FROM retail.inventory i JOIN retail.warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id JOIN retail.products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE p.category_id = 37 AND w.region = 'Region 5' GROUP BY w.region ORDER BY stock DESC

SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MIN(ordered_at) AS first_order, MAX(ordered_at) AS last_order FROM retail.customer_orders WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2024-01-21' - INTERVAL '365 days' AND order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY order_count DESC, last_order DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.ordered_at, o.total_amount FROM retail.customer_orders o LEFT JOIN retail.payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'pending' AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2023-03-07' AND (p.payment_id IS NULL OR p.payment_status = 'failed') ORDER BY o.ordered_at LIMIT 250

SELECT carrier, shipment_status, COUNT(*) AS shipments, AVG(delivered_at - shipped_at) AS avg_delivery_time FROM retail.shipments WHERE carrier = 'DHL' AND shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND shipped_at >= DATE '2023-03-04' - INTERVAL '180 days' AND shipped_at < DATE '2023-03-04' + INTERVAL '180 days' AND (delivered_at IS NULL OR delivered_at - shipped_at > INTERVAL '72 hours') GROUP BY carrier, shipment_status ORDER BY shipments DESC

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(p.payment_id) AS payments, SUM(p.amount) AS lifetime_value FROM pagila.customer c JOIN pagila.payment p USING (customer_id) WHERE c.customer_id >= 262 GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(p.payment_id) >= 3 ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) FILTER (WHERE f.rating = 'G') AS g_revenue, SUM(p.amount) FILTER (WHERE f.rating = 'PG') AS pg_revenue, SUM(p.amount) FILTER (WHERE f.rating = 'R') AS r_revenue FROM pagila.payment p JOIN pagila.rental r USING (rental_id) JOIN pagila.inventory i USING (inventory_id) JOIN pagila.film f USING (film_id) WHERE p.payment_date >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2022-01-01' AND p.payment_date < TIMESTAMPTZ '2022-02-01' GROUP BY i.store_id ORDER BY i.store_id

SELECT f.film_id, f.title FROM pagila.film f WHERE f.rating = 'NC-17' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pagila.inventory i JOIN pagila.rental r USING (inventory_id) WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id ) ORDER BY f.title

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM pagila.customer c WHERE c.activebool = true AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pagila.rental r WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id AND r.rental_date >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2022-04-01' ) ORDER BY c.customer_id

SELECT i.film_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.store_id = 1) AS store_one, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.store_id = 2) AS store_two FROM pagila.inventory i WHERE i.film_id >= 3 GROUP BY i.film_id HAVING ABS(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.store_id = 1) - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.store_id = 2)) >= 3 ORDER BY i.film_id

SELECT p.customer_id, p.payment_date, p.amount, lag(p.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date) AS previous_amount, p.amount - lag(p.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date) AS delta FROM pagila.payment p WHERE p.customer_id >= 491 ORDER BY p.customer_id, p.payment_date

SELECT date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) AS month, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT p.customer_id) AS customers FROM pagila.payment p JOIN pagila.staff s USING (staff_id) WHERE s.store_id = 2 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT i1.film_id AS first_film, i2.film_id AS second_film, COUNT(DISTINCT r1.customer_id) AS shared_customers FROM pagila.rental r1 JOIN pagila.inventory i1 USING (inventory_id) JOIN pagila.rental r2 ON r2.customer_id = r1.customer_id AND r2.rental_id > r1.rental_id JOIN pagila.inventory i2 ON i2.inventory_id = r2.inventory_id WHERE i1.film_id < i2.film_id GROUP BY i1.film_id, i2.film_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r1.customer_id) >= 2 ORDER BY shared_customers DESC LIMIT 40

SELECT co.country, ci.city, COUNT(cu.customer_id) AS customers FROM pagila.country co JOIN pagila.city ci USING (country_id) JOIN pagila.address a USING (city_id) LEFT JOIN pagila.customer cu USING (address_id) WHERE co.country_id <= 81 GROUP BY co.country, ci.city ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 60

WITH activity AS ( SELECT c.customer_id, c.store_id, MAX(r.rental_date) AS last_rental FROM pagila.customer c LEFT JOIN pagila.rental r USING (customer_id) WHERE c.store_id = 2 GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.store_id ) SELECT customer_id, last_rental, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY last_rental DESC NULLS LAST) AS recency_rank FROM activity ORDER BY recency_rank, customer_id

SELECT p.customer_id, p.payment_date, p.amount, AVG(p.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg FROM pagila.payment p WHERE p.customer_id BETWEEN 18 AND 68 ORDER BY p.customer_id, p.payment_date

SELECT a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rentals, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS revenue FROM pagila.actor a JOIN pagila.film_actor fa USING (actor_id) JOIN pagila.inventory i USING (film_id) LEFT JOIN pagila.rental r USING (inventory_id) LEFT JOIN pagila.payment p USING (rental_id) WHERE a.actor_id >= 89 GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT c.name, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.amount) AS median_payment, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.amount) AS p90_payment FROM pagila.category c JOIN pagila.film_category fc USING (category_id) JOIN pagila.inventory i USING (film_id) JOIN pagila.rental r USING (inventory_id) JOIN pagila.payment p USING (rental_id) WHERE p.amount >= 4.99 GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY p90_payment DESC

SELECT co.country, COUNT(DISTINCT cu.customer_id) AS customers, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM pagila.country co JOIN pagila.city ci USING (country_id) JOIN pagila.address a USING (city_id) JOIN pagila.customer cu USING (address_id) JOIN pagila.payment p USING (customer_id) WHERE co.country_id >= 13 GROUP BY co.country ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rentals FROM pagila.customer c JOIN pagila.rental r USING (customer_id) WHERE c.customer_id >= 244 GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(r.rental_id) >= 30 ORDER BY rentals DESC
SELECT c.customer_id FROM retail.customers AS c WHERE c.customer_id <= 40 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail.customer_orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id) > 0
SELECT p.product_id FROM retail.products AS p WHERE p.product_id <= 20 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail.order_items AS i WHERE i.product_id = p.product_id) > 0

SELECT i.order_id, i.line_no FROM retail.order_items AS i WHERE i.order_id <= 50000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail.customer_orders AS o WHERE o.order_id = i.order_id) > 0
SELECT p.payment_id FROM retail.payments AS p WHERE p.payment_id <= 30000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail.customer_orders AS o WHERE o.order_id = p.order_id) > 0
SELECT tf.ticket_no, tf.flight_id FROM aviation.ticket_flights AS tf WHERE tf.ticket_no <= '0000000050000' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aviation.tickets AS t WHERE t.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no) > 0
SELECT bp.ticket_no, bp.flight_id FROM aviation.boarding_passes AS bp WHERE bp.flight_id <= 10000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aviation.flights AS f WHERE f.flight_id = bp.flight_id) > 0
SELECT r.rental_id FROM pagila.rental AS r WHERE r.rental_id <= 5000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pagila.inventory AS i WHERE i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id) > 0

SELECT c.customer_id FROM retail.customers AS c WHERE c.customer_id <= 70 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail.customer_orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id) > 0
SELECT p.product_id FROM retail.products AS p WHERE p.product_id <= 35 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail.order_items AS i WHERE i.product_id = p.product_id) > 0
SELECT b.book_ref FROM aviation.bookings AS b WHERE b.book_ref <= '000035' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aviation.tickets AS t WHERE t.book_ref = b.book_ref) > 0
SELECT f.film_id FROM pagila.film AS f WHERE f.film_id <= 350 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pagila.inventory AS i WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id) > 0
SELECT o.order_id FROM retail.customer_orders AS o WHERE o.order_id <= 20000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail.order_items AS i WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id) > 0
SELECT t.ticket_no FROM aviation.tickets AS t WHERE t.ticket_no <= '0000000075000' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aviation.ticket_flights AS tf WHERE tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no) > 0
SELECT i.inventory_id FROM pagila.inventory AS i WHERE i.inventory_id <= 3000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pagila.rental AS r WHERE r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id) > 0
SELECT i.order_id, i.line_no FROM retail.order_items AS i WHERE i.order_id <= 75000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail.customer_orders AS o WHERE o.order_id = i.order_id) > 0
SELECT p.payment_id FROM retail.payments AS p WHERE p.payment_id <= 50000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail.customer_orders AS o WHERE o.order_id = p.order_id) > 0
SELECT tf.ticket_no, tf.flight_id FROM aviation.ticket_flights AS tf WHERE tf.ticket_no <= '0000000075000' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aviation.tickets AS t WHERE t.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no) > 0
SELECT bp.ticket_no, bp.flight_id FROM aviation.boarding_passes AS bp WHERE bp.flight_id <= 20000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aviation.flights AS f WHERE f.flight_id = bp.flight_id) > 0
SELECT r.rental_id FROM pagila.rental AS r WHERE r.rental_id <= 10000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pagila.inventory AS i WHERE i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id) > 0
SELECT p.payment_date, p.payment_id FROM pagila.payment AS p WHERE p.payment_date < TIMESTAMPTZ '2022-04-01' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pagila.customer AS c WHERE c.customer_id = p.customer_id) > 0
SELECT c.customer_id FROM retail.customers AS c WHERE c.customer_id <= 100 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail.customer_orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id) > 0
SELECT p.product_id FROM retail.products AS p WHERE p.product_id <= 50 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail.order_items AS i WHERE i.product_id = p.product_id) > 0
SELECT b.book_ref FROM aviation.bookings AS b WHERE b.book_ref <= '000050' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aviation.tickets AS t WHERE t.book_ref = b.book_ref) > 0
SELECT f.film_id FROM pagila.film AS f WHERE f.film_id <= 500 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pagila.inventory AS i WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id) > 0
SELECT o.order_id FROM retail.customer_orders AS o WHERE o.order_id <= 30000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail.order_items AS i WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id) > 0
SELECT t.ticket_no FROM aviation.tickets AS t WHERE t.ticket_no <= '0000000100000' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aviation.ticket_flights AS tf WHERE tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no) > 0
SELECT i.inventory_id FROM pagila.inventory AS i WHERE i.inventory_id <= 4000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pagila.rental AS r WHERE r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id) > 0
SELECT i.order_id, i.line_no FROM retail.order_items AS i WHERE i.order_id <= 100000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail.customer_orders AS o WHERE o.order_id = i.order_id) > 0
SELECT p.payment_id FROM retail.payments AS p WHERE p.payment_id <= 70000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail.customer_orders AS o WHERE o.order_id = p.order_id) > 0
SELECT tf.ticket_no, tf.flight_id FROM aviation.ticket_flights AS tf WHERE tf.ticket_no <= '0000000100000' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aviation.tickets AS t WHERE t.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no) > 0
SELECT bp.ticket_no, bp.flight_id FROM aviation.boarding_passes AS bp WHERE bp.flight_id <= 30000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aviation.flights AS f WHERE f.flight_id = bp.flight_id) > 0
SELECT r.rental_id FROM pagila.rental AS r WHERE r.rental_id <= 15000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pagila.inventory AS i WHERE i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id) > 0
SELECT p.payment_date, p.payment_id FROM pagila.payment AS p WHERE p.payment_date < TIMESTAMPTZ '2022-05-01' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pagila.customer AS c WHERE c.customer_id = p.customer_id) > 0
